title: Boy in Knit Cardigan, Fullerton California - Vintage 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
FADE PROOF
SEP 6 1938
Finished by B. D. WOOD
Fullerton, California
817 A
description: Full-length outdoor portrait of a well-groomed young boy standing with hands politely held behind his back next to a sunlit house wall and window draped in climbing vines. He wears a dark, buttoned knit cardigan sweater over a collared dress shirt with a diagonally striped tie, paired with crisp white trousers and white shoes—a classic preppy, athletic-inspired look typical of late 1930s youth fashion in Southern California. The back bears a photo processing stamp from B. D. Wood in Fullerton, California, dated September 6, 1938.
